app_tagline: Free food and items, near you
app_intro: People share food and items that are waiting on the street for anyone who needs them. You can take them for free.
footer_note: This information comes from people like you. Before eating, check that the food looks and smells fine.
location_error: We couldn't find your location. Make sure location (GPS) is turned on and try again.
sorted_by_distance: The list is sorted by distance from you.
empty_body: Saw something free on the street? Share it so someone else can enjoy it.
map_label: Map of finds. You can switch to the list view.
map_failed: We couldn't load the map. You can use the list instead.
expires_in: Will be removed from the map {time}
new_intro: Saw food or items waiting for someone? Tell everyone. No sign-up needed.
use_my_location: I'm there now: use my location
location_set: Location marked. Tap the map or drag the pin to adjust it.
location_pick_hint: You can also tap the exact spot on the map.
location_needs_js: To mark a location, please turn on JavaScript in your browser.
picker_map_label: Map for marking the location. Tap where the find is.
field_description_hint: For example: a box of fruit and vegetables, a sofa in good condition. Up to {max} characters.
field_hint_hint: For example: next to the bin, behind the grocery store.
error_description_too_long: The description is too long. Up to {max} characters.

footer_rikma: {app} is built as a rikma on {brand}: an open partnership of developers, content reviewers and volunteers.
spots_intro: Places where free food or items show up often. For example, a bakery that leaves bread out in the evening, or a corner where people leave clothes. There isn't always something there, so check what others said.
spots_empty_body: Know a place where free food or items show up often? Add it.
spots_map_label: Map of hot spots. You can switch to the list view.
spots_promo: There are also hot spots: places where free food or items show up often.
new_spot_suggest: Are things like this there often, not just today?
spot_new_intro: Tell us about a place where free food or items show up often. No sign-up needed.
spot_picker_map_label: Map for marking the location. Tap where the hot spot is.
spot_field_description_hint: For example: the bakery leaves pastries in a box by the entrance. Up to {max} characters.
spot_field_when: When is it best to come? (optional)
spot_field_when_hint: For example: in the evening after the shop closes, mostly on Thursdays.

spot_visit_unusable: There was something, but not in good condition
spot_visit_stopped: The place stopped giving, or it closed
